notes: These are authored acceptance intervals in metres, not previously measured results. Check candidate only using the actual compiled checkpoint.
Major shells are closed revolved boundaries. Require manifold edges and positive finite volume; the thin enamel liner intentionally has much smaller volume than the metal shade.
Dimensions refer to world-space axis-aligned bounding box lengths, not local generator parameters.

The mast axis is X=-0.075m and the shade axis X=0.045m; the revised arrangement reserves visible clearance outside the opening. Curved-part collision and cable contact still require rendered inspection.
The 200m floor is an environment plane; it is intentionally open and excluded from closed-volume checks.
